query: Hey, I just wanted to say I had the best iced matcha latte from that new café down the street this morning, they added a little vanilla foam on top and it was so creamy I’m already thinking about going back tomorrow. Oh and I also picked up the cutest phone pop socket on my way home, it’s shaped like a little avocado and it’s already saved my phone from slipping out of my hand twice today. I had a really great walk with my golden retriever after dinner too, he chased a butterfly all the way across the park and made everyone around laugh. Anyway, I’m having an issue with my phone right now, my data saver mode is turned on and I already used up all my data for the month, and now none of my apps that need internet are working properly, can you help me fix this?
